title: agent-memory: file ingest and skill packaging
description: Feature container for the ingest command, SKILL.md, apm.yml, and test suite. All concrete work is expressed in child beads.
acceptance_criteria: memory.py ingest notes.txt adds at least one chunk and prints a summary line to stderr
A .txt file with 3 paragraphs produces 3 separate memory rows
A .md file with a ## Section heading produces a chunk starting with that heading
memory.py ingest data.json with [{"content":"hello"},{"content":"world"}] adds exactly 2 rows
memory.py ingest data.csv --column text adds one row per CSV data row with other columns as metadata
Chunks shorter than 10 characters are skipped and counted in the summary
memory.py ingest unknown.xyz exits 1 with unsupported format error
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/ passes with all tests green
SKILL.md exists with valid frontmatter and a When to use this skill section
apm.yml is valid YAML with name, version, description, author, dependencies, scripts
